The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an 'I can do that' mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

About SwimOutlet.com SwimOutlet.com is one of the largest online specialty retailers for swimming, aquatics, and the beach lifestyle in North America. We supply everything from competitive swimwear and goggles to lifeguard and rescue equipment, deck gear, and aquatic fitness essentials.

Beyond individual athletes and families, we partner with the organizations that run the water: parks, pools, patrols, and programs that need reliable gear at scale. We're building out our enterprise sales function to deepen those partnerships — and we're looking for someone who can own it.

About the Role SwimOutlet is looking for a driven, relationship-focused Facility Sales Representative to grow our business with aquatic facilities and organizations.

In this role you'll own a territory of accounts—municipal and community pools, YMCAs, colleges and universities, K–12 schools, swim clubs, fitness centers, resorts, and other aquatic facilities—and serve as their trusted partner for swimwear, training equipment, deck and pool gear, lifeguard supplies, and team apparel.

You'll be responsible for the full sales cycle: prospecting new facilities, deepening existing relationships, understanding each facility's operational and seasonal needs, and delivering solutions that keep their programs and staff equipped year-round.

Reporting to the VP of Sales and Service, you'll be a key contributor to the growth of SwimOutlet's facility and B2B business. What You'll Do Own and grow a book of facility accounts, driving revenue against monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.

Prospect and qualify new facility opportunities through outbound outreach, referrals, industry events, and inbound leads. Build long-term relationships with aquatics directors, facility managers, coaches, purchasing agents, and other decision-makers.

Consult with facilities to understand their programming, headcount, seasonal cycles, and budgets, then recommend the right product mix. Prepare quotes, proposals, and bulk/team orders; manage pricing within approved guidelines.

Coordinate with customer service, operations, and fulfillment to ensure accurate, on-time delivery and a smooth account experience. Manage the pipeline and account activity in the CRM, keeping records, forecasts, and next steps current.

Handle contract renewals, reorders, and account issues, resolving problems quickly to protect and grow the relationship. Stay current on product lines, new arrivals, and category trends to advise customers credibly. Partner with marketing and leadership on facility-focused promotions and initiatives.

Represent SwimOutlet at trade shows, aquatic conferences, and regional events as needed. Who you are Experience selling to aquatic facilities, athletic departments, schools, or in sporting goods / team dealer channels. Familiarity with the aquatics, swim, or fitness industry (personal involvement in swimming a plus).

Experience with team/bulk ordering, custom apparel, or facility supply programs. Willingness to travel within territory and attend industry events. 2+ years of B2B sales, account management, or inside/outside sales experience, ideally with a track record of hitting quota. Strong relationship-building, consultative selling, and negotiation skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to and following up with decision-makers. Organized and self-directed, able to manage a full pipeline and prioritize across many accounts. Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and standard sales/productivity software.

Comfort working toward revenue targets in a metrics-driven environment. Success Looks Like Consistently meeting or exceeding sales and margin targets for the assigned territory. A growing base of active, satisfied facility accounts with strong retention and reorder rates. Accurate forecasting and a well-managed, healthy pipeline.

Facilities who view SwimOutlet as their go-to partner for aquatic and team needs. Why SwimOutlet SwimOutlet is one of the largest online destinations for swim, water, and active gear, serving athletes, coaches, facilities, and communities.

You'll join a collaborative Sales & Service team, sell products you can believe in, and have a direct hand in growing an established B2B channel. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary plus commission / performance bonus. Health, dental, and vision coverage. 401(k) with company match. Paid time off and holidays.

Generous employee discount on SwimOutlet products. Home-office / remote-work support and covered business travel. Originally posted on Himalayas

Uncapped commission with a competitive OTE: your earnings scale with the pipeline and the deals you help create

A dedicated 1:1 partnership with a senior Account Executive who coaches you every week, not a shared BDR pool
Six-figure enterprise deals and reference clients across pharma, insurance, telecom, FMCG, retail and automotive
Direct access to the founders and real influence on how we sell

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly.

Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required. Please include MONTH/YEAR and HOURS per week for all previous work experience listed on the resume. If there is no indication of time in position, we will credit the minimum.

Als B2B Sales Development Representative spielst du eine zentrale Rolle im Wachstum von FINN. Du gewinnst neue Geschäftskunden, generierst hochwertige Leads und übergibst diese an unsere erfahrenen Account Executives. Dabei verstehst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Kundinnen, begeisterst sie für das Thema AutoAbo und kannst dein Know-how voll einbringen.
Die Rolle bietet dir die ideale Chance, deine Karriere im Sales aktiv zu gestalten und Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen. Du sammelst nicht nur wertvolle Vertriebserfahrungen, sondern trägst maßgeblich zur Entwicklung und Unterstützung unseres Teams bei. In unserem dynamischen Umfeld kannst du dein Vertriebstalent voll entfalten und deine berufliche Zukunft aktiv vorantreiben.

Lead Generierung: Du bist maßgeblich verantwortlich für das Gewinnen neuer, hochwertiger Leads und das Wachstum von FINN, indem du potentielle Kunden durch Kaltakquise ansprichst und für FINN begeisterst. Anschließend stellst du eine reibungslose Übergabe an unsere B2B Account Executives sicher.
Prospecting: Du unterstützt unser Team beim Research und Prospecting von relevanten Branchen und Firmen mit dem Anspruch, die perfekte Zielgruppe anzusprechen. Dabei entwickelst du passende Strategien für eine effektive Ansprache.
Entwickle deine Markt- und Produktkenntnis weiter: Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für unser Angebot, wodurch du flexibel und professionell auf Anliegen potenzieller Geschäftskunden reagieren kannst.
Sammle Kundenanforderungen: Durch deinen kontinuierlichen Austausch mit potentiellen Kunden verstehst du deren Bedürfnisse. Mit der Sammlung, Validierung und Weitergabe der Anforderungen an unser Management trägst du erheblich dazu bei, neue Chancen für existierende und neue Kundengruppen zu entdecken und unser Angebot weiterzuentwickeln.
Leadership: Übernimm die Führung und Entwicklung unserer Sales Interns. Unterstütze sie dabei, alle notwendigen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse für den Vertriebserfolg zu erwerben, und begleite das Team auf dem Weg zur Erreichung seiner Verkaufsziele.
Your Profile

Ausbildung & Track Record: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften), kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz im B2B-Outbound-Sales und Cold Calling .
Kommunikation & Überzeugungskraft: Exzellente sprachliche und schriftliche Argumentationsfähigkeit, hohe Resilienz sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen in einem dynamischen Hyper-Growth-Umfeld .
Eigenverantwortung & Zielerreichung: Ausgeprägte Selbstorganisation, lösungsorientiertes Handeln und eine datengetriebene Arbeitsweise zur kontinuierlichen Überfüllung deiner Sales-Quoten .
Sprachkenntnisse: Exzellente/Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift .

Leadership & Coaching Experience: Erste praktische Erfahrung im Mentoring, Peer-Coaching oder der fachlichen Führung von Sales Interns bzw. Junior SDRs .
Sales Tech Stack: Versierter Umgang mit modernen CRM- und Sales-Prozess-Tools (wie HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach oder Salesloft) .

Shared Success (VSOP Finanzbeteiligung): Wir gewinnen gemeinsam. Über unser Virtual Stock Option Program profitierst du direkt vom langfristigen Wertwachstum und dem Erfolg von FINN.
Fuel your Growth (1.500€ Weiterbildungsbudget): Stillstand ist keine Option. Mit deinem jährlichen Development-Budget in Höhe von 1.500€ für Fortbildungen und Seminare entscheidest du selbst, wie du dich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickelst.
Family First (Kita-Zuschuss & Flexibilität): Wir unterstützen dich und deine Familie. Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung , exklusiven Zugängen zu Kita-Plätzen in München sowie maximaler Flexibilität, um Berufs- und Familienleben stressfrei zu vereinbaren.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV): Wir denken an deine Zukunft. FINN bezuschusst deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem starken Arbeitgeberanteil von 66 % .
Experience our Product (25% Auto-Abo Rabatt): Werde selbst zum FINN-Driver! Du erhältst einen satten Mitarbeiterrabatt von 25% auf dein Auto-Abo oder nutzt alternativ unser attraktives Fahrrad-Leasing (Bike-Leasing) .
Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit): Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für Fitness und Sport sowie professionellem Mental Health Support.
Munich Office Life: Barista-Kaffee auf Knopfdruck, Matcha und der legendäre Obstkorb erwarten dich in unserem modernen Headquarter in München . On top gibt es einen täglichen Lunch - Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen .
Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam.

FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor.

Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an!

s.h: FIXING THE PLANET BY MAKING HOMES CARBON-FREE!
s.t:
Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird, sondern wie und mit wem.
Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater begleiten wir energetische Sanierungen ganzheitlich — von der ersten Frage bis zur installierten Wärmepumpe oder PV-Anlage. 2025 haben wir dieses Wissen konsequent in den Vertrieb gebracht: jedes Haus ein Einzelfall, jede Lösung passgenau. Mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und 80 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.
Unser Vertriebsinnendienst ist in den letzten zwei Jahren von einer Handvoll Leuten zu einem festen Team gewachsen. Die Zahlen stimmen. Was fehlt, ist jemand, der das Team führt, entwickelt und aus einer eingespielten Truppe ein System macht, das auch das nächste Wachstum trägt.
Unser Angebot
85.000 € Zielgehalt, davon 55.000 € Grundgehalt. Dein variabler Anteil hängt an der Leistung Deines Teams, nicht an Deiner eigenen Anwahlliste
Ein Team, das steht: keine Wackelkandidaten, keine Sanierungsaufgabe. Du übernimmst Leute, die liefern, und holst mehr raus
Direkter Draht zum Head of Sales, kurze Wege, echte Entscheidungsspielräume. Die Prozesse für Dein Team baust Du selbst
Wir stellen weiter ein. Dein Team wächst, während Du es führst
Zwei Tage Homeoffice, drei Tage Büro in Kreuzberg — Coaching am Hörer funktioniert nur live
Dein Spielfeld
Du führst das Pre-Sales-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch: Coaching am Hörer, Call-Reviews, 1:1s, Entwicklungspläne
Du steuerst über Zahlen — Speed to Lead, Anwahlfrequenz, Booking-Rate, Show-Rate, Conversion in Abschlüsse. Und Du erkennst, ob hinter einer Zahl ein Prozess klemmt oder jemand im Team Unterstützung braucht
Du baust die Grundlagen: Gesprächsleitfäden, Einwandbehandlung, Onboarding für neue Leute, Dokumentation, die auch funktioniert, wenn Du im Urlaub bist
Du gestaltest die Verschiebung unseres Provisionsmodells von Volumen zu Qualität mit. Wir sind von 70/30 auf 50/50 gegangen und wollen auf 30/70. Gleiche Frequenz, härterer Qualitätsanspruch: Ein Termin zählt für Dein Team erst richtig, wenn daraus ein Abschluss wird
Du pitchst selbst. Nicht jeden Tag, aber oft genug, dass Dein Team weiß, dass Du es kannst
So passt du in's Team
Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre ein Vertriebsteam von sechs oder mehr Leuten geführt — Inside Sales, SDR, Terminierung, Telefonvertrieb. Die erste Führungsrolle ist diese hier nicht
Du kommst selbst aus dem Vertrieb und hast Zahlen verantwortet, bevor Du sie von anderen eingefordert hast
Du arbeitest mit Daten statt mit Bauchgefühl: Du kannst benennen, welche Kennzahl Du in Deinem letzten Team bewegt hast, um wie viel, und was Du dafür konkret geändert hast
Du schreibst Dinge auf. Prozesse, Entscheidungen, Leitfäden — nicht weil es jemand verlangt, sondern weil Du weißt, was sonst passiert
Du führst über Verbindlichkeit, nicht über Lautstärke. Und Du kannst beides: Ansprüche stellen und Leute dort abholen, wo sie stehen

Spreeblick statt Hinterhof: unser Büro liegt direkt am Wasser, mitten in Kreuzberg
Zwei Remote-Tage pro Woche, der Rest live mit dem Team
Ein Learning-Budget, das auf Deine Entwicklung einzahlt – fachlich oder querbeet
Urban Sports Club, Jobticket, Kita-Zuschuss – je nachdem, was in Deinem Leben gerade zählt
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Du begleitest Menschen dabei, ihre Häuser nachhaltiger zu machen – Energiewende zum Anfassen

**Finding the talent that makes Deloitte unique**
Innovation and tax consultancy may not seem to go together, but that-s exactly what you-ll find at Deloitte. We-re constantly seeking the new and working together to push the limits of what-s possible. Join our Tax Transformation Consulting team as a consultant, where you will help clients design and implement practical technology solutions for tax compliance, reporting, accounting and advisory challenges.
In this role, you will contribute to (global) engagements, and together with our broader tax advisory teams, provide international organisations with leading services on global tax compliance, tax accounting and tax advisory - ultimately enabling our clients to successfully navigate the changing Swiss and international tax landscape.
**How you can make an impact**
* Contribute to client engagements from day one, working with tax, technology and business teams to deliver practical solutions across industries.
* Support go-to-market activities and tax technology watch by translating emerging trends into relevant client insights.
* Build a clear, long-term career path through professional training, mentoring and targeted support for relevant tax technology qualifications.
* Help clients transform tax processes for the digital age by designing and implementing clear, fit-for-purpose technology solutions.
* Contribute to advisory work on tax operating models, process improvement and tax risk management.

* You are curious, collaborative and solution-oriented, with the confidence to take responsibility and work with clients in a respectful and structured way.
* You bring a strong interest in process design, project work and business topics, and you enjoy developing new perspectives together with multidisciplinary teams.
* You hold a bachelor's or master-s degree in science, IT/technology engineering or economics and can demonstrate your technology savviness and interest in tax matters.
* You have gained relevant experience through internships, student work or first professional roles in consulting, tax, technology, analytics or process transformation.
* You communicate confidently in English; German or French and experience in business process mapping, tax technology solutions, data management, reporting or analytics are an advantage.
**Your Team**
Become part of a growing, multidisciplinary team with offices across Switzerland. Our team explores new technologies that bring value to our clients and combines curiosity, teamwork and interdisciplinary collaboration across business lines. We will help you grow both personally and professionally through trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning.

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.
In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors.

We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.
